# awscc_cloudwatch_view (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::View. A view is a named, reusable SQL query that can be referenced from CloudWatch telemetry queries. View names must be unique within the account and region.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) The SQL query that defines the view.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the view.
- `name` (String) The name of the view. Must begin with the "view." prefix followed by lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores. View names must be unique within the account and region. If not specified, a name is generated.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the view.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the view was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `type` (String) The ownership category of the view. Views created through CloudFormation are always USER views; MANAGED views are provisioned by AWS.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the view was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_view.example
  identity = {
    name = "name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the view

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_view.example
  id = "name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cloudwatch_view.example "name"
```
